## New

- **Clearer names.** The menu options are now **Corrigir ortografia**, **Polir texto com IA**, **Polir texto como…** and **Polir com instrução…**.
- **Smarter AI rewrite.** The AI now works out what kind of text you selected (bug report, change log, summary, title, message or instruction) and formats it to match.
- **Polir texto como…** lets you pick the kind of text yourself.
- **Polir com instrução…** opens a box where you say what you want, like "deixe mais formal".
- **Preview.** See the text before and after, edit the result, then apply, copy or try again. Can be turned off in the settings.
- **Editable prompt** for your own Gemini key or Ollama, with a button to restore the default.
- **Automático** Gemini model: tries the best model first and skips the ones that are busy or out of quota.

## Improved

- **Faster AI.** The main model answers without extra "thinking", and when a model is slow the next one starts in parallel.
- **Lists, headings and quotes** keep their markers, and each item is polished on its own line.
- Links and code can now appear more than once in the answer (for example, in **Problema** and **Ação**).
